most people buy clothes for the version of themselves they want to be on saturday night.

forget that. dress for your 2pm meeting on a tuesday.

that one guy who wears the exact same silhouette every day of the year.

he’s not uninspired. he’s just figured it out.

we skipped the chest pocket on the new button-downs.

it ruins the drape and nobody actually keeps anything in there anyway.
